references.text: The parallel genealogy in Genesis mentions the same sons of Simeon: Jemuel, Jamin, Ohad, Jakin, Sohar and Saul, the son of the Canaanite woman.
The census in Numbers lists Simeon's descendants and their clans, with some name variations: Nemuel (Jemuel), Jamin, Jakin, Serah (Sohar) and Saul.
Chronicles gives another version of Simeon's sons: Nemuel, Jamin, Jarib, Serah and Saul, which partially matches the list in Exodus.
Simeon's birth is described here, where Leah names him because the Lord heard that she was unloved.
Another version of Simeon's genealogy confirming the names and structure of the patriarchs, although the spelling varies.
Thematic parallel: Both verses highlight that the patriarchs (Judah and Simeon) had children with Canaanite women.
